code_first.q: Predict which sorted-list front value is output first during a merge of example storage sizes.
code_first.code:
leftGB = 4
rightGB = 2
if leftGB < rightGB then
    print(leftGB)
else
    print(rightGB)
endif
p: Explain why knowing total storage requirements is different from merely sorting file sizes.
code_first.a: Initially 2 is printed; with rightGB = 8, the first selected value is 4. Sorting arranges values but does not calculate storage required; a capacity calculation must add sizes. This is only the first comparison in the merge step.
